extracted.intended_audience: Rospatent staff, patent attorneys, IP policy makers, state customers/contractors involved in federally funded R&D
extracted.subtask_description: Standards, procedures, and quality criteria used by Rospatent for (1) electronic filing services, (2) certification and registration of patent attorneys, and (3) audits/control of state-funded R&D results and related administrative proceedings. Covers service features, exam rules, audit triggers, typical violations, and processing-time goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic filing coverage (what can be filed online)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rospatent official website allows filing applications for registration of all objects of intellectual property except for topographies of integrated circuits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statistics show high uptake (share of requests filed at the official website of the total amount of electronic applications is usually higher than 90%), indicating demand for electronic services. Rospatent plans to continue developing and expanding electronic services and to introduce new services (e.g., the 'Single channel interaction' information system).

rubrics_metrics.name: Required functionalities of electronic interaction services
rubrics_metrics.description: Electronic interaction services must provide formation and filing of applications, obtaining information on the status of proceedings, delivering documents on the result of state services, filing pre-trial (extrajudicial) appeals against decisions and acts (inaction) of Rospatent/FIPS and their officials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State and post-registration services, fee payment for electronic services, and quality assessment of provision of state services are provided via EPGU. These features are considered part of the expected electronic-service offering.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Cabinet service functionality
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'Personal Cabinet' (updated Jan 14, 2019) must support filing applications for industrial designs, computer programs and databases directly via the service; filing industrial design applications according to the Hague Agreement; working on draft applications and viewing filed applications (for those filed via the service); and automatic registration of received correspondence signed with digital signatures for certain filings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Automatic registration applies to correspondence concerning inventions and utility models (if filed on paper or via PatDoc), trademarks, appellations of origin or grants of exclusive right to appellations of origin registered earlier (if filed on paper), and industrial designs/computer programs/databases filed via the updated service. These features are listed as enhancements to improve electronic filing usability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promotion and channeling of electronic filing (EPGU vs official site)
rubrics_metrics.description: Services that are among the most popular but not provided on Rospatent's site are made available via the Public Services Portal of the Russian Federation (EPGU); for services provided on the official site, the majority of electronic applications are filed directly through that official website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High share of filing via official website (often >90%) is used as an indicator of demand and effective interface design tailored to IP state services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support, training and outreach for electronic filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Provision of training video courses/programs, technical support service for electronic services, and individual training to help applicants prepare electronic application documents for patents, utility models, industrial designs, trademarks, appellations of origin, computer programs and databases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples of published video materials with view counts are given; FIPS technical support registers and considers requests (working days) with 24/7 submission by email; individual training in a computer hall is free and conducted by appointment. These measures are cited as organizational/technical/information steps that increased electronic filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certification and registration of patent attorneys (general standard)
rubrics_metrics.description: A citizen who obtained the status of patent attorney as provided by law and who carries out activities in the sphere of legal protection of intellectual activity results and means of individualization is deemed a patent attorney; Rospatent carries out certification and registration, issues registration certificates, and controls compliance with legislative requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expansion of number of attorneys and development of a competitive attorneys' services market are priority actions. Rospatent performs oversight of compliance and issues/excludes attorneys per statutory grounds (e.g., Federal Law No. 316-FZ).

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintaining the Register of patent attorneys (timeliness and reliability)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rospatent maintains the Register of patent attorneys and ensures timely updating of information; timely updating of attorney information is a duty of the patent attorneys and a Rospatent function to provide reliable information useful for finding high-quality services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statistics on distribution and regional imbalances are monitored; failure to timely update can harm availability of services and geographic access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Qualification exam specializations and exam administration
rubrics_metrics.description: The qualification exam for certification of patent-attorney candidates and attorneys wishing to expand specialization is conducted in five specializations: 'Inventions and utility models', 'Industrial designs', 'Trademarks and service marks', 'Appellations of origin', 'Computer programs, databases, topographies of integrated circuits'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rospatent Qualification Commission checks candidates' documents, prepares and carries out exam sessions, and makes certification decisions. Examples of practical and situational tasks for the written part and (for the first time) example computer testing questions are published to support pre-exam training. Candidates may be allowed to file for certification in no more than two specializations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentary compliance requirements for admission/exclusion (grounds under Federal Law No.316-FZ)
rubrics_metrics.description: Candidates may be refused admission or excluded when lack of compliance with the requirements to patent attorneys provided by parts 2 and 3 of Article 2 and part 13 of Article 6 of the Federal Law No. 316-FZ of December 30, 2008 is identified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Qualification Commission examines submitted documents and may deny admission or certification where statutory requirements are not met; specific numbers of non-admitted and excluded candidates are reported as outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeals and complaints handling for attorney certification
rubrics_metrics.description: An Appeals Commission considers complaints of candidates and patent attorneys (e.g., complaints against decisions of the Qualification Commission).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appeals Commission organizes meetings, considers complaints, and records outcomes (e.g., number of complaints satisfied/denied). The report provides counts and trends by specialization and year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal basis and scope for audits of state-funded R&D IP results
rubrics_metrics.description: Control and supervision in the sphere of legal protection and utilization of results of intellectual activity created with federal budget funding and in protection of State interests are performed by Rospatent in accordance with Statute (Decree No.218) and Government Decrees Nos. 9 and 402.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audits target state customers and organizations–state contractors engaged in R&D (civil, military, special and dual use). The socially significant goal is improving efficiency of R&D, achieving worldwide novelty, legal protection and involvement in economic turnover.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of audits and triggers
rubrics_metrics.description: Audits include scheduled on-site audits, unscheduled on-site audits (including those conducted at request of the Prosecutor General’s Office), scheduled document audits, and unscheduled document audits upon expiry of periods given to comply with previous orders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In 2019 Rospatent carried out 67 audits of state customers/contractors including scheduled and unscheduled audits; scheduled on-site audits were carried out in multiple federal districts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection criterion for auditing state contracts
rubrics_metrics.description: Selection of state contracts (agreements) for audit is made mainly according to the criterion of expected effectiveness of R&Ds in terms of the results of intellectual activity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audits of organizations–contractors considered many contracts with significant federal funding; results include counts of protectable results and registration activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expectations for state customers' IP management (strategic and procedural obligations)
rubrics_metrics.description: State customers must have strategic documents reflecting goals of managing rights to results of intellectual activity, requirements to created/used results, and measures aimed at achieving worldwide novelty and prior art analysis; they must organize registration of rights and state inventory of results per Rules (Decree No.233).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audit found shortcomings where work was limited to broadly treating developed documentation as know‑how or scientific work rather than actively managing registration and disposal of rights; absence of required activities (e.g., sending decisions to contractors) is noted as non-compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Common violations detected in audits (procedural non-compliance list)
rubrics_metrics.description: Detected violations include: failure to check applications for state secrets; ambiguity in designation of rightholders in state contracts; improper registration activities that misstate ownership (e.g., claiming joint ownership without basis); failure to carry out state inventory of results; failure by contractors to notify state customer of creation of protectable results; failure of state customer to send decisions on form of legal protection to contractor; failure to send patent-research reports; and failure to conduct required patent research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 567 violations of compulsory legislative requirements were detected among considered contracts; audits resulted in orders to eliminate violations. Specific example: Roscosmos had created protectable results but had not registered rights or sent required decisions to contractors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audit outcomes and remedial action (orders to eliminate violations)
rubrics_metrics.description: Following audits, acts of audits are drawn up and orders on elimination of detected violations are issued to state customers and organizations–contractors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In the sample year, audits of organizations–contractors resulted in 29 orders to eliminate detected violations; Rospatent tracks these remedial actions as part of supervision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Processing time goals for appeals and requests
rubrics_metrics.description: Average time limits for consideration of appeals and requests: in 2019, 4 months regarding means of individualization and 4.8 months regarding patent-law objects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rospatent considers measures to reduce time limits of consideration of disputes; these averages are presented by object type and used to evaluate administrative performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision outcomes on appeals (satisfaction/denial statistics as performance metric)
rubrics_metrics.description: Decisions taken on appeals and requests are tallied and categorized by whether appeals/requests were satisfied or not (e.g., in 2019: 2,242 decisions; 1,111 satisfied, 1,131 not satisfied).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The report breaks down decisions by object type (inventions, utility models, industrial designs, trademarks, appellations of origin) and analyzes year-to-year dynamics to assess Rospatent's dispute-resolution activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of exam training materials and computer testing examples
rubrics_metrics.description: Rospatent publishes examples of practical and situational tasks for the written part of the qualification exam and, for the first time, examples of questions for computer testing to provide self-study pre-exam training.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Updating these materials is explicitly cited as a measure to improve candidate preparation and standardize exam expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limit on number of specializations a candidate may apply for
rubrics_metrics.description: Candidates are allowed to file applications for certifying in no more than two specializations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This procedural limit is enforced during application processing and reflected in application statistics.
